sans.$description: Display and body. Load via next/font/local from Fontshare.

mono.$description: Metadata, labels, metrics, dates. Load via next/font/google.

size.$description: 1.25 major-third ratio. Base 17px desktop (16px mobile via CSS clamp or media query). sm=13px covers secondary labels below base.

bold.$description: 700 — Satoshi ships 300/400/500/700/900; no 600. Max 3 weights still satisfied.

tracking.$description: Letter-spacing. Display uses tight negative tracking; body uses default.

wide.$description: Mono labels and ALL CAPS metadata only
